scope: Enemy class11 revenant and class14 brigand art review only

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art spritesheet for the enemy roadside BRIGAND, using reference1 as exact pose/handedness blueprint and reference2 ONLY for restrained color and visual detail standard. New identity: sturdy short-haired raider, short solid-navy hair, sleeveless blue-purple rough tunic, mauve belt, dark trousers and ankle boots, muscular bare forearms, compact SHORT-HANDLED AXE. No long sword, shield, cape or knight armor. Use exactly the restrained enemy swordmaster design language: dark navy #172638 outline and SOLID hair; muted blue-purple #4f4f7d fabric; light grey lavender #bbc1d6 trim; muted skin #dda77d; purple shadow #373e64; muted mauve #a394b1 sash. Only these six flat material colors, no gradients, no gloss, no hair highlights or clothing highlights; preserve structural dark shadows. Soft, readable, NOT grey/dull, no neon. Exact 4-column 2-row sheet, 8 complete independent sprites. All battle bodies face LEFT in three-quarter profile as reference. Read blueprint labels in order: row1 original8 idle crouch axe held diagonally before chest; original9 stepping with rear leg tucked; original10 opposite foot phase; original11 wide forward step. Row2 original12 close step; original13 raise axe hand over head, other arm guarding ahead; original15 low forward followthrough after a chop, axe down front; original8 repeated idle. Reproduce every head tilt, body lean, shoulder/elbow/hand placement, leg stance and weapon angle shown by the source silhouette, do not substitute generic idle poses. Each pose complete, consistent body proportions and same scale. 12% transparent margin in each equal cell, no overlaps. Clean precise pixel clusters, production 4x redraw of tiny native sprite, NOT blurry painted art. Transparent background; no labels, grids, ground, shadows or attack effect arc (the original arc will be added in code).

Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art MAP spritesheet, exact 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 sprites, following reference1 pose arrangement exactly. Reference2 is only enemy swordmaster COLOR and detail standard, do NOT copy armor or sword. Character a sturdy short-haired roadside brigand, solid dark navy cropped hair without highlights, sleeveless muted blue-purple rough tunic, mauve cloth belt, dark trousers, ankle boots, sturdy bare forearms, compact short axe retained close to torso in same hand; no long sword or armor. Six flat colors only: #172638 navy outline/solid hair; #4f4f7d blue-purple cloth; #bbc1d6 muted light trim; #dda77d skin; #373e64 purple shadow; #a394b1 mauve. Matte and slightly low saturation but readable, no gradients, no shiny highlights. Row1: 3 original idle poses 0,1,2 and repeat0. Row2: original walk0 back-view feet phaseA; walk1 back-view phaseB; walk2 full RIGHT profile phaseA; walk3 RIGHT profile phaseB. Row3: walk4 front-view phaseA; walk5 front-view phaseB; walk6 full LEFT profile phaseA; walk7 LEFT profile phaseB. Preserve exact native arm position, shoulder width, hunch, handedness and alternating foot/leg stance shown by each source. Back views genuinely show back, side views show side torso. Within each direction pair hold head/neck and hip center at precisely same screen coordinate, same height/size, no whole-body bob or sway; only limbs change. Two legs, two arms, no duplicate limbs. Draw full-body clean pixel shapes meant to resolve at 24x24 native scale with fourfold detail. Consistent scale, feet baseline, separate equal cells with 15% transparent margin, no clipping. Transparent background, no labels, grid, floor or shadows (stable ground shadow added separately).

Use case: stylized-concept. Production tactical RPG pixel-art spritesheet for enemy REVENANT (蚀躯), a gaunt corrupted human-shaped undead with EMPTY claw hands, bald cold pale grey-lavender head, no hair highlights, torn sleeveless blue-purple tunic and ragged dark purple trousers, bare long hands and feet, stooped thin shoulders. Not a female swordswoman, no weapon, no staff, no armor. Reference1 is the exact native animation body pose guide; reference2 is only the blue-purple low-saturation enemy palette standard. Six matte flat colors: #172638 navy outline; #4f4f7d muted blue-purple cloth; #bbc1d6 grey-lavender flesh/light; #8f8da6 secondary flesh; #373e64 violet structural shadow; #a394b1 mauve cloth. No shiny highlights, gradients, neon, glowing eyes or blood. Crisp expressive pixel clusters, clean silhouette, soft readable colors. EXACT 5 columns x 3 rows, 15 pose cells matching reference1 one-for-one, including intentionally shrinking/sinking poses. Row1: native33 standing arms down;34 begins to soften knees into ground;35 sinks to 85% standing height;36 sinks to 72%;37 sinks to60%. Row2:38 about45% height with head still showing and arms merging downward;39 about30% height;40 about20% tiny hunched half-submerged remains;41 a very low 8% mound;42 an almost-flat narrow residue on ground, NO upright body. Preserve the progressive height change shown, do not draw all cells same height. Row3:43 fully emerged standing with one forearm reaching diagonally to LEFT;44 raise that arm bent to shoulder;45 extend arm diagonally upward-left;46 arm straight overhead-left;48 aftermath of sweeping claw attack, leaning sharply LEFT with long arm extended high-back and other arm hanging, exactly matching reference silhouette. All bodies face LEFT as source. Same character dimensions/materials across standing frames; sinking is intentional dissolving/slumping into floor, NOT merely bending over. Feet/bottom at same baseline each cell, generous complete transparent margins, no labels or grid, no ground shadows or slash arc. Do not add extra actors. Strongly follow each pose's anatomy and arm silhouette.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production tactical RPG pixel-art MAP spritesheet for enemy REVENANT (蚀躯). A gaunt corrupted human-shaped undead, bald cold pale grey-lavender head, empty long hands, stooped thin shoulders, torn sleeveless muted blue-purple tunic, ragged dark violet trousers, bare long hands and feet. No weapon, shield or armor. Reference1 gives exact native poses and order; reference2 only the refined blue-purple ENEMY palette standard. Six matte flat colors: #172638 navy outline; #4f4f7d blue-purple cloth; #bbc1d6 grey-lavender flesh/light; #8f8da6 flesh shadow; #373e64 violet structural shadow; #a394b1 mauve cloth. Soft low saturation but readable and not muddy, no gradients, neon, gloss or highlights on head/clothing. EXACT 4 columns x 3 rows 12 separate complete map sprites. Row1: native idle0, idle1, idle2, idle0 repeat. Row2: original walk0 BACK view first foot phase; walk1 BACK view alternate foot; walk2 full RIGHT profile first leg phase; walk3 RIGHT profile alternate leg phase. Row3: walk4 FRONT view first leg phase; walk5 FRONT view alternate leg; walk6 full LEFT profile phaseA; walk7 LEFT profile phaseB. Match the blueprint's stoop, arm placement, bent elbows, hanging hands, alternating feet and knees, torso facing. Exactly two arms and two legs. For each direction pair lock head/neck and waist/hip center in place: no global bob or lateral shifting, no scale drift; limbs move relative to same center. Original gait is a shambling alternating walk, not walking in place by shifting the entire drawing. Every cell has same complete character scale, generous transparent margin, consistent foot baseline. Crisp detailed pixel-art that reads at24x24 native scale, no soft painterly edges, no labels, no grid, no floor/shadow (ground shadow added separately).

Use case: production pixel-art asset repair. Draw 5 corrected full-body MAP sprites of the exact same enemy brigand in reference 1. Output 3 columns x 2 rows equal cells, row1: idle1 FRONT (fix missing axe); back-view WALK B; right-facing profile WALK B. Row2: front-view WALK B; left-facing profile WALK B; repeat idle1. Reference2 is original pose/limb intent. Preserve character proportions, clothing, 6 flat matte colors (#172638 navy outline and SOLID unhighlighted hair, #4f4f7d fabric, #bbc1d6 light trim, #dda77d skin, #373e64 shadows, #a394b1 belt), small clean pixel blocks. NO new shiny hair/clothes effects.
CRITICAL: every walking B pose must actually exchange the two legs compared with the first phase in reference1; do not redraw the same planted foot. Back B: screen RIGHT boot is now lower/forward and screen LEFT boot is lifted/back (reverse reference row2 col1). Right B: camera-near RIGHT leg and boot clearly pulled BACK behind hips to screen LEFT, opposite FAR leg extends FORWARD to screen RIGHT; keep two visibly separate legs, no extra leg. Front B: screen LEFT boot planted forward/lower, screen RIGHT leg bent/lifted/back (reverse reference row3 col1). Left B: camera-near LEFT leg/boot pulled BACK to screen RIGHT, opposite FAR leg reaches FORWARD screen LEFT. Side views must show true side torso as reference. All second phases keep exact same head, shoulder/neck and waist position relative to body, no body jumping or side drift.
Axe continuity: compact short-handled axe is ALWAYS present, same anatomical hand. Front walking axe appears on screen LEFT as original front first-phase, with silver blade by left chest, fist gripping dark handle; back walking axe screen RIGHT; right profile axe in front to screen RIGHT; left profile axe in front to screen LEFT. Idle1 axe screen RIGHT at shoulder, elbow pose slightly differs from idle0. No free-floating weapon, no hand switching, no missing handle. Same stance height and body scale. Transparent background, ample margins, full feet and axe visible, no labels, grid or ground shadows.

Use case: pixel-art game animation correction. Two FULL-BODY sprites side by side only, same bald gaunt revenant from reference1, exactly same hunch/head/arms/torso. LEFT cell faces screen RIGHT, RIGHT cell faces screen LEFT. They are the CLOSED-STEP / PASSING phase of his shuffle walk, corresponding to original reference2 row2col4 and row3col4. Critical DIFFERENCE from reference1: reference1 side poses all show an extended stride. Draw legs MUCH CLOSER together underneath the hip, one leg supporting straight-ish with foot below pelvis, other knee slightly bent and passing directly alongside it, foot lifted by only a few pixels. Do NOT leave a foot stretched far out in front and the other far behind. Two feet only. In right-facing sprite the near leg is back/passing, far leg now takes support; in left-facing sprite reverse gait consistent with left side. Exact hunched shoulders and large low-hanging empty claw hands; preserve head's forward position, trunk lean, hip center and top-of-head height, no entire body bob or side drift. Match original FE2 closed-step silhouette in reference2 while retaining the new character design from ref1. Same skinny bald undead, solid pale grey-lavender head/skin, ragged muted blue-purple sleeveless garment, mauve cloth, dark shadows, bare feet, empty hands, no hair/weapon/shield. Six matte colors #172638 #4f4f7d #bbc1d6 #8f8da6 #373e64 #a394b1; no glossy highlights or gradients. Crisp clean pixel shapes and readable shadow contour. Keep ample transparent cell margins, same scale/proportions as ref1. Transparent background. No text/grid/shadows/floor.
